wikitext.*: During the day, merchants sell a wide variety of items including [[Ingredients|ingredients]], [[Drinks|drinks]], [[Cuisines|cuisines]], recipes, and [[Kitchenwares|kitchenware]] in exchange for various currencies. Each merchant has a specific inventory that can change each day based on the probability of each item being for sale. Additionally, merchants sell items at a varying percentage of their in-game value, meaning some merchants can offer better deals than others on the same item. The "Merchant Rate" perk, gained from levelling, allows the player to purchase items using fewer yen. It starts from 100% at Lv0 and maxes out at 70% at Lv50.
